title: Fix test_node.py collection ImportError (PEER_DB_MAX_SIZE moved to peers.py)
description: python/tests/test_node.py:47 imports PEER_DB_MAX_SIZE from lichen.node, but the in-flight uncommitted node.py/peers.py changes define it in lichen.peers. Collection error aborts 'pytest -k link or frame' runs regardless of -k filtering. Discovered during project-LICHEN-2auf.35.2 verification.
